title: Concept: Go pprof profiling index disclosed in a response
description: The Go pprof index page lists the CPU, heap, goroutine and trace profiles the process serves. A heap profile contains live object contents, so a publicly reachable pprof handler is a memory disclosure as well as a denial-of-service lever.
applicability: Responses served by a Go process that imports net/http/pprof on its public mux.
risk: Memory, goroutine and execution traces are downloadable; MEDIUM severity because the heap routinely contains credentials.
